prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one landscape 2048x1152 finished concept design board for a gothic fairy-tale deckbuilding game. Four complete portrait modal interfaces side by side at equal size with slim dark gutters: (1) 手牌一览, a fan-of-cards painted emblem, HP / Energy / Spirit resource chips, three illustrated card entries with readable rules, text-size slider, footer 返回战斗; (2) 旅人指南, an open painted journal emblem, three-step progress, heading 先看敌人下一步, a short explanatory paragraph and highlighted example box, buttons 下一步 and 暂时跳过; (3) 收藏与成就, antique brass laurel medal emblem, eight compact achievement tiles in 2 columns with some gold unlocked and some muted locked, accordion rows 卡牌 遗物 敌人, footer 返回; (4) 存档管理, sealed scroll and archive-case emblem, storage-location inset, large buttons 导出备份 and 导入存档, status text area and footer 关闭. Consistent quiet aged ivory parchment backgrounds, engraved brass vine nine-slice frames, charcoal indigo surroundings, warm amber accents, dark real-looking readable typography. Hand-painted watercolor prop illustrations and restrained ornament. Every panel has a clear header, scrollable body and fixed bottom action area. Refined practical game UI, strong hierarchy, accessible controls and generous breathing space. No characters or skulls, no device mockup, no perspective, no extra gameplay features, no English filler paragraphs, no watermark. This is the complementary concept board for four utility UI surfaces in the same game; all panels must be fully visible.
note: Visual direction only. Generated sample text, card stats, achievements and save paths are not authoritative. Runtime uses existing definitions and real fonts.
